findings.title: Verify does not check token expiration
findings.description: Authenticator.Verify returns a session even if its ExpiresAt time has passed, allowing expired tokens to be used indefinitely.

findings.title: BearerToken may panic on malformed Authorization header
findings.description: The function splits the header on a space and accesses parts[1] without verifying that the split produced two elements, which can cause an out-of-range panic.

findings.title: RequireAdmin uses incorrect logical operator
findings.description: The condition `if s.Role != "admin" || s.Role != "owner"` is always true, rejecting all requests, even for admins or owners.

findings.title: sessions map is accessed without synchronization
findings.description: Authenticator.sessions is a plain map accessed concurrently by Issue, Verify, and Revoke, which can cause data races and undefined behavior.

findings.title: Cache.Get mutates state while holding a read lock
findings.description: Get increments the hit counter and updates the entry's last‑used timestamp, and also deletes expired entries, all while holding an RLock. This breaks the RWMutex contract and can cause races.

findings.title: Cache.evict can deadlock by calling Get under an exclusive lock
findings.description: evict is called while Cache.mu is locked, but it invokes c.Get which tries to acquire an RLock, leading to a deadlock.

findings.title: Cache.Delete returns while holding the mutex when key is absent
findings.description: If the key does not exist, Delete returns without unlocking c.mu, leaving the mutex locked for the rest of the program.

findings.title: Cache.Peek reads map without synchronization
findings.description: Peek accesses c.m without any locking, which can race with concurrent writers.

findings.title: Cache.Stats returns hit count without locking
findings.description: The hits counter is updated under a lock but read without one, causing a data race.

findings.title: NewStore does not initialise quota map
findings.description: Store.quota is nil, so any later write (e.g., s.quota[owner]++) will panic.

findings.title: Create increments quota on a nil map
findings.description: s.quota[owner]++ dereferences a nil map, causing a runtime panic on the first link creation.

findings.title: Store.Resolve expiration logic is inverted
findings.description: The code deletes a link when it is still valid (now before ExpiresAt) and keeps it when expired, reversing the intended behavior.

findings.title: Rename validates the source code twice, never validates destination
findings.description: Both validation calls use `from`, so an invalid `to` code can be accepted, while a valid `to` may be rejected.

findings.title: Page slicing may go out of bounds (off‑by‑one)
findings.description: When `end > len(all)`, the code sets `end = len(all) + 1`, which can cause a slice panic.

findings.title: Quotas returns internal map by reference
findings.description: callers can mutate the returned map, corrupting the store’s internal state.

findings.title: Top returns least‑used links due to ascending sort
findings.description: The comparator sorts hits in ascending order, so the slice `all[:n]` yields the lowest‑hit links instead of the most popular.

findings.title: Extend can resurrect expired links
findings.description: Extend unconditionally sets ExpiresAt to now+ttl, contradicting the comment that an already‑expired link must stay expired.

findings.title: Prune returns total remaining links instead of number removed
findings.description: The function computes `removed` but finally returns `len(s.links)`, misleading callers.

findings.title: Redirect lower‑cases the short code
findings.description: `strings.ToLower(code)` changes the case of generated base64 codes, causing lookup failures because codes are case‑sensitive.

findings.title: writeJSON sets headers after WriteHeader
findings.description: Headers (Content‑Type, CORS) are set after calling `w.WriteHeader`, so they are not sent to the client.

findings.title: Metrics.AddResolved has a value receiver
findings.description: The method updates a copy of Metrics, leaving the real counters unchanged; resolved metrics are always zero.

findings.title: WarmCache adds to WaitGroup inside goroutine
findings.description: Calling `wg.Add(1)` after the goroutine starts can race with `wg.Wait`, potentially causing a panic or premature return.

findings.title: CheckTargets may panic if mustHead returns nil request
findings.description: `client.Do(mustHead(u))` passes a nil request when the URL cannot be parsed, leading to a runtime panic.

findings.title: mustHead returns nil request on error
findings.description: When `http.NewRequest` fails, the function logs the error but still returns a nil request, which callers treat as valid.

findings.title: StartJanitor deletes from store without synchronization
findings.description: The janitor goroutine removes expired entries from `s.links` directly, while other goroutines may read or write the map, causing data races.

findings.title: ExportCSV creates world‑readable file
findings.description: The file is written with mode 0666, contradicting the comment that only the service user should read it; other users on the host can access exported data.

findings.title: CACHE_TTL parsed as seconds instead of milliseconds
findings.description: `LINKD_CACHE_TTL_MS` is interpreted with `time.Second`, making the configured TTL 1000× larger than intended.

findings.title: Fetch limit environment variable is parsed but never applied
findings.description: `LINKD_FETCH_LIMIT` is read and validated, but the resulting value is discarded (`_ = limit`).

findings.title: Unsynchronized access to Authenticator.sessions map
findings.description: Authenticator holds a mutable map `sessions` that is written by Issue (line 52), read/iterated by Verify (line 60‑64) and deleted by Revoke (line 106) from many HTTP handler goroutines without any mutex. Concurrent reads/writes to a Go map can cause data races and panics ("concurrent map read and map write").

findings.title: Deadlock in Cache.evict due to re‑entrant lock
findings.description: `Cache.evict` is called with `c.mu.Lock()` held (by Set), but it calls `c.Get` which attempts `c.mu.RLock()`. A RWMutex is not re‑entrant, so the goroutine blocks forever, causing the cache eviction path to hang.

findings.title: Cache.Get writes shared fields under a read lock
findings.description: `Get` acquires `c.mu.RLock()` and then updates `e.used` and `c.hits++`. Multiple concurrent `Get` calls can race on these writes because a read lock allows multiple readers, leading to a data race and incorrect hit counting.

findings.title: Cache.Peek reads map without synchronization
findings.description: `Peek` accesses `c.m` without any locking, while other methods (Set, Delete, evict) modify the map concurrently. This can cause a concurrent map read/write panic.

findings.title: WaitGroup misuse in WarmCache leads to race/panic
findings.description: `wg.Add(1)` is called inside the goroutine *after* the goroutine has started, while `wg.Wait()` is called immediately after launching all goroutines. If `Wait` runs before any `Add`, the counter is zero and `Wait` returns, after which a goroutine may call `Add` or `Done`, causing a panic (negative counter) or deadlock.

findings.title: CheckTargets may leak goroutines on early error return
findings.description: When an error is received from `results`, the function returns immediately (line 100) without draining the remaining sends on the unbuffered `results` channel. Remaining workers block forever on `results <- err`, leaking goroutines and possibly exhausting resources.

findings.title: Store maps accessed concurrently without any synchronization
findings.description: `Store` holds `links` and `quota` maps that are read and written by many methods (Create writes at line 54‑55, Resolve reads/modifies at line 60‑68, Delete removes at line 134, Prune iterates/deletes at lines 197‑204) and by the Janitor goroutine (worker.go line 50‑53). No mutex protects these maps, leading to data races, possible panics, and lost updates.

findings.title: Predictable session tokens
findings.description: Session tokens are generated with `math/rand`, which is not cryptographically secure. An attacker can predict future tokens and impersonate any user, including admin accounts.

findings.title: Authorization header parsing may panic
findings.description: `BearerToken` splits the `Authorization` header and blindly accesses `parts[1]`. A missing or malformed header triggers an index‑out‑of‑range panic, causing a denial‑of‑service.

findings.title: Deadlock in cache eviction
findings.description: `Cache.evict` acquires the exclusive lock then calls `c.Get`, which attempts a read lock. This classic RWMutex deadlock can freeze the process under load.

findings.title: Path traversal in CSV export
findings.description: `ExportCSV` builds the output file path with `filepath.Join(dir, name+".csv")` where `name` comes from a query parameter. Supplying `..` components can escape `ExportDir` and overwrite arbitrary files on the host.

findings.title: Admin endpoint authorized by mutable header
findings.description: `adminQuotas` trusts the `X-Admin` request header instead of verifying the session role. Any client can set the header to "true" and retrieve all owners' quotas.

findings.title: Open redirect in `/out` endpoint
findings.description: The `next` query parameter is redirected to without validation, enabling phishing attacks and open‑redirect abuse.

findings.title: Link deletion lacks ownership check
findings.description: `deleteLink` calls `store.Delete` without confirming that the authenticated session’s owner matches the link’s owner. Any authenticated user can delete any other user’s link.

findings.title: Quota map not initialized
findings.description: `NewStore` creates a `Store` with a nil `quota` map. The first call to `Create` panics when `s.quota[owner]++` is executed, leading to a complete service crash.

findings.title: Nil quota map dereference on link creation
findings.description: After a link is created, the code increments `s.quota[owner]++` on a nil map, causing a runtime panic that can be triggered by any user creating a link.

findings.title: Resolve deletes valid (non‑expired) links
findings.description: `Resolve` mistakenly deletes a link when `time.Now().Before(l.ExpiresAt)` (i.e., when the link is still valid). This causes premature link disappearance and a denial‑of‑service for legitimate users.

findings.title: Page pagination can cause slice out‑of‑bounds
findings.description: When `offset+size` exceeds the slice length, `end` is set to `len(all)+1`, which makes the subsequent slice operation panic.

findings.title: `mustHead` may return nil request
findings.description: `mustHead` logs an error but still returns `nil` when `http.NewRequest` fails. `CheckTargets` then calls `client.Do(nil)`, causing a panic and a possible denial‑of‑service.
